dataset_name: CoolShield AI Synthetic Dubai Building Telemetry

ground_truth_anomalies.title: HVAC Efficiency Degradation
ground_truth_anomalies.description: Gradual drop in Coefficient of Performance (COP) from 3.8 to 2.45 due to condenser coil scaling and dust accumulation, leading to 35% higher electric draw per ton of refrigeration.
ground_truth_anomalies.expected_action: Condenser coil chemical washing and refrigerant pressure check.

ground_truth_anomalies.title: Suspected Major Water Leak
ground_truth_anomalies.anomaly_type: Abnormal Continuous Water Flow / Pipe Rupture
ground_truth_anomalies.description: Uninterrupted nighttime water flow surge of ~4.8x normal baseline in the hotel spa basement piping loop, wasting ~28 m3 per day.
ground_truth_anomalies.expected_action: Emergency isolation of Spa Zone Valve B-04 and physical pipe inspection.

ground_truth_anomalies.title: Unexpected Overnight Energy Consumption
ground_truth_anomalies.anomaly_type: After-Hours HVAC Schedule Override / Stuck Damper
ground_truth_anomalies.description: Commercial office VAV and AHU system running at 100% capacity between 11 PM and 5 AM during an un-cleared manual BMS override.
ground_truth_anomalies.expected_action: BMS schedule reset and damper actuator recalibration.

ground_truth_anomalies.title: Faulty Temperature Sensor & Data Gap
ground_truth_anomalies.anomaly_type: Sensor Drift & Intermittent Communication Packet Loss
ground_truth_anomalies.description: Floor 28 Modbus temperature transmitter calibration drifting by +7.5°C with 42% missing packet telemetry, falsely triggering localized over-cooling.
ground_truth_anomalies.expected_action: Recalibrate or replace Modbus RTU temperature transmitter.

limitations: Data is synthetically generated for simulation and competition demonstration only.
Weather profiles simulate typical Dubai climate conditions (22C to 48C) with seasonal drift.
Physical building control interfaces are disabled; all work orders require human operator approval.
